value.rationale: An infinite, canonical low-minimum-degree cactus family has an exact structural inventory of every optimal strong-majority colouring, an explicit six-term exponential count and a quantitative asymptotic. The necessity that rim colours lie in a globally missing-spoke set couples independent triangle blades and reveals why generic degree and existence bounds miss fine solution structure. This is a natural complete classification rather than a renamed baseline coloring construction.
